## Xperi Inc. to Release Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 4


October 14, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/329092987/files/content_files/Xperi-announces-date-of-3rd_Q_earnings.pdf)


SAN JOSE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Xperi Inc. (NYSE: XPER) (the “Company” or “Xperi”), an entertainment technology company that invents, develops, and delivers technologies that enable extraordinary experiences, will announce its Third Quarter 2026 financial results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, following the close of the market.


The Company will host an earnings conference call at 2 p.m. PT (5 p.m. ET) that same day. To access the Company’s earnings conference call:


**Participant Dial-in Details:**


USA / International Toll +1 585-542-9983
North America Toll-Free +1 833-461-5787
Conference ID: 134 945 759


All participants should dial in 15 minutes prior to the start of the call using the conference ID listed above. Alternatively, the call can be accessed via the following link:[Q3 2026 Earnings Call Webcast](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fnam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com%2F%3Furl%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.google.com%252Furl%253Fq%253Dhttps%25253A%25252F%25252Fevents.q4inc.com%25252Fattendee%25252F134945759%2526sa%253DD%2526source%253Dcalendar%2526usd%253D2%2526usg%253DAOvVaw2IbaqmUKWwz1gZcvWsh84x%26data%3D05%257C02%257Cidalia.rodriguez%2540arboradvisorygroup.com%257Cf2b21d9d8a7e491f8b7808df23e296c7%257C8a515f2ffb224c41aa4434b35e38502b%257C0%257C0%257C639269128553301575%257CUnknown%257CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%253D%253D%257C0%257C%257C%257C%26sdata%3Dvcqn4PtDA00M9xnic3cQYF6njw3Ky1kvyJDOJR7Iobk%253D%26reserved%3D0&esheet=54621167&newsitemid=20261014306770&lan=en-US&anchor=Q3+2026+Earnings+Call+Webcast&index=1&md5=6b89370a655f1c6ff0f07f85bab52ddc) .


**About Xperi Inc.**


Xperi invents, develops, and delivers technologies that enable extraordinary experiences. Xperi technologies, delivered via its brands (DTS®, HD Radio™, TiVo®), are integrated into consumer devices and media platforms worldwide, powering smart devices, connected cars and entertainment experiences, including IMAX® Enhanced, a certification and licensing program operated by IMAX Corporation and DTS, Inc. Xperi has created a unified ecosystem that reaches highly engaged consumers, driving increased value for partners, customers and consumers.
